component.name: Orbit Tape
component.summary: Native crypto charting desk for the COSMIC desktop

description.p: Orbit Tape is a COSMIC-focused fork of Flowsurface, a native desktop charting app for crypto markets. It streams trades and order books straight from the exchanges and draws them as heatmaps, footprint and candlestick charts, time and sales, and a DOM ladder.

ul.li: Order book heatmap, candlestick footprint and volume profile charts
Follows the COSMIC theme, including light and dark mode
Binance, Bybit, Hyperliquid, OKX and MEXC market data

screenshot.caption: Candlestick, heatmap and order flow panes

description.p: First Orbit Tape release: Linux and COSMIC only, new name and icon, indicator alerts, COSMIC theme and frosted glass support.
